name: IMPECCABLE
summary: Design intelligence with 23 commands and 45 deterministic detector rules: init a design context once, then craft, audit, polish, critique, animate, and iterate with a shared vocabulary.

cursor.rule_description: Use when a task builds or reviews any visual interface — layout, components, typography, color, motion, or accessibility. Skip for pure backend, API, DB, or DevOps work.
